source_review.notes: Checked all twelve structured references. Current OCI runtime configuration supports process identity, capabilities, namespaces, mounts, devices, cgroups, sysctls, seccomp, LSM labels, and resource fields. Current Linux kernel cgroup v2 documentation supports hierarchical CPU, memory, I/O, PID, cpuset, pressure, and delegation semantics. Linux man-pages 6.18 support namespace types, capability sets and scope, and user-namespace mappings. Current Kubernetes guidance supports non-root identity, privilege escalation, seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, privileged overrides, Pod Security Restricted controls, resource request/limit behavior, cgroup enforcement, QoS, and RuntimeClass selection. Current gVisor documentation supports the shared-host resource dependency, reduced host-system-call surface, residual side channels, and compatibility/performance trade-offs. No source is treated as proof of complete isolation or universal configuration.
